eventmodeling
tf 01 rmo Inventory.Stock
tf 02 ui ProductPage
tf 03 cmd AddItem { description: string }
tf 04 evt ItemAdded [[AddItem01]]
tf 05 pcr Pricing.Recalculate `json`{ "currency": "EUR" }

data AddItem01 {
  description: 'john'
}
